# Data-quality audit — MedAI-EPI training/eval corpora

*Generated by `scripts/data_quality_audit.py`. No compute; inspection of committed data + code only.*

This report checks (A) note↔target consistency, (B) target field-population %, (C) enum-value distributions across corpora, (D) PATIENT_ID prompt-line consistency, (E) prompt-template drift.

## D. PATIENT_ID prompt-line consistency (train vs inference)

The v2 augmentation training prepends `PATIENT_ID: SYNPID_XXX` to each training note. Inference must use the identical format.

**Train-side augmentation line** (finetune_lora_epi.py):

```python
unknown
```

**Inference-side prepend line** (run_med42_on_pilot.py):

```python
# When a LoRA adapter is loaded, prepend "PATIENT_ID: <pid>" to the
```

Both should emit `PATIENT_ID: <id>\n\n<note>`. If they don't, the adapter's copy-from-prompt mechanism will not fire at inference.

---

## E. Prompt-template drift check

The finetune script uses `PROMPT_TEMPLATE` from `finetune_lora_epi.py`. The runner uses templates from `services/prompt_registry.py`. These need to agree on the 'note goes here, phenotype JSON here' structure.

**Training prompt template** (`finetune_lora_epi.py::PROMPT_TEMPLATE`):

```python
PROMPT_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract the epilepsy phenotype from this clinical text into the "
    "MedAI-EPI v0.2.1 JSON schema. Return only valid JSON.\n\n"
    "Clinical text:\n\"\"\"\n{note}\n\"\"\"\n\n"
    "Phenotype JSON:\n"
)
```

**Inference prompts** are constructed per-arm/module in `services/prompt_registry.py`. They are *different* from the training PROMPT_TEMPLATE — they include few-shot examples (M1) or schema fragments (M2), and always emit one *module* JSON at a time, not the full EpilepsyPhenotype.

**⚠ Potential mismatch**: training targets are the FULL `EpilepsyPhenotype` (all modules in one JSON), but inference prompts ask for ONE module (e.g. `ClinicalSeizureModule`). The `smart_repair.py` unwrap fix (commit `e158d51`) is what reconciles the mismatch by extracting the requested inner module from a full-phenotype emission. If we ever remove that fix, all tuned outputs will fail validation again.
